For Assessors

This prototype is a single self-contained page — no install, no login required. Suggested walkthrough order:

  1. Customer (default view) — Home → Book a Chair → Services → Location → Shop → Log In / Create Account
  2. Use the role switcher pinned to the bottom of the screen to preview the other two roles:
  3. Barber — My Bookings → click any booking to open the checkout (POS)
  4. Admin — Products (add/remove stock) → Accounts (create/edit logins)

All data (bookings, products, accounts) is seeded in the browser for demo purposes and resets on refresh — nothing here is connected to a real database yet.

About Us

Built on Trust

Kinsman is a classic barbershop on Mackeurtan Ave — the kind of place where you get the same chair, the same barber, and a cut you don't have to explain twice.

Six barbers work out of the shop, each with their own specialty, from precision fades to traditional straight-razor shaves. No rush, no upsell — just proper tools and a chair that's warm when you get there.
